question: Can one current legal topology snapshot distinguish a stable topology from a just-lost or just-recovered topology, and does one previous legal topology snapshot resolve any observed ambiguity?

allowed: current and previous legal graph topology extraction
forbidden: actor, critic, GRU or TATG implementation
failure identity, onset or duration as an actor input
reward, transition, sampler or environment modification

scripted_environment.action: fixed neutral discrete action index 13 for every blue agent

exclude: global share observation and centralized critic state
return, reward and all evaluation artefacts

target: transition class derived only from the difference between consecutive legal communication relation adjacencies: stable, loss, recovery or mixed
history: one immediately preceding legal topology snapshot; no hidden environment variable is retained as history

decision_rule.pass: each cohort meets every threshold; a PASS establishes only a topology-transition information gap
decision_rule.fail: any threshold failure yields TATG_P1_NO_INFORMATION_GAP and closes TATG before architecture implementation

pass_authorizes_only: a separately authorized exact-formula, fairness and serialization audit; not model implementation or PPO training
